question: How does facility delivery coverage compare across districts in each year?

view.title: Facility Delivery Coverage by District and Year
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of recorded deliveries that occurred in a health facility. Use the year selector to focus on a single year or compare all three years side by side. Values are illustrative and are not official statistics.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The report supplies percentages only; it does not supply counts or causal explanations for why coverage differs between districts.
